title: Feature Writing
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the waste of human resources and the continual closure of schools."
The biggest tragedy is the waste of human resources and the continual closure of schools.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means understanding all kinds of scientific, technical, social and political information."
Knowledge means understanding all kinds of scientific, technical, social and political information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a sort of report on the style of the director as well as the quality of the acting involved."
Reviews are a sort of report on the style of the director as well as the quality of the acting involved.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same, whether the crime is at the instance of the drunken AD thug or the overzealous PDP knight."
The feeling of outrage is the same, whether the crime is at the instance of the drunken AD thug or the overzealous PDP knight.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an invaluable tool to students of journalism, reporters and editors, researchers and social historians."
The book is an invaluable tool to students of journalism, reporters and editors, researchers and social historians.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the root of vandalism, terrorism, lawlessness, poverty and acts of irresponsibility being witnessed in Nigeria today."
The failure of education is the root of vandalism, terrorism, lawlessness, poverty and acts of irresponsibility being witnessed in Nigeria today.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a serious business and it should be taken as such."
Writing a Travel Guide is a serious business and it should be taken as such.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common aspect of a feature story."
The profile is the most common aspect of a feature story.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a story that accompanies a main story."
A sidebar is a story that accompanies a main story.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same whether the atrocities are at the hands of the militant Jukun warrior or Tiv zealot."
The sense of indignation is the same whether the atrocities are at the hands of the militant Jukun warrior or Tiv zealot.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a course in mass communication which involves and explores the creative abilities of the journalist to its fullest; and uses the journalist's literary skills maximally."
Feature Writing is a course in mass communication which involves and explores the creative abilities of the journalist to its fullest; and uses the journalist's literary skills maximally.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a representation of the reality of certain experiences or the creative production of real life experiences."
A documentary is a representation of the reality of certain experiences or the creative production of real life experiences.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a descending spiral, begetting the very thing it seeks to destroy, and destroying the very thing it claims to defend."
Let them see that violence is a descending spiral, begetting the very thing it seeks to destroy, and destroying the very thing it claims to defend.
fib: ______ is the landing aid with precision approach system which provides the pilot with both lateral and vertical guidance towards landing on the runway.
Agbeyegbe says the ILS

______ is a specialist in the area he is reporting and as such, he is knowledgeable in that area.
special correspondent
The special correspondent is a specialist in the area he is reporting and as such, he is knowledgeable in that area.
______ means that the feature writer or news gatherer must be able to go the extra mile to reach the heart of news irrespective of the obstacles he will face in the process.
Being resourceful
Being resourceful means that the feature writer or news gatherer must be able to go the extra mile to reach the heart of news irrespective of the obstacles he will face in the process.
______ is the primary focus of any paper.
editorial
The editorial is the primary focus of any paper.
______ is a mother of three. "One day, I went to the market, leaving the children at home.
Solape Ebiye
Solape Ebiye is a mother of three. "One day, I went to the market, leaving the children at home.
______ are known to influence, condemn, commend, advocate, inform, educate, plead, entertain and even pay tributes to deserving individuals.
Editorials
Editorials are known to influence, condemn, commend, advocate, inform, educate, plead, entertain and even pay tributes to deserving individuals.
______ is a colourful story about people, events, places and life.
feature story
A feature story is a colourful story about people, events, places and life.
______ is the writer's way of disseminating information.
interview feature story
The interview feature story is the writer's way of disseminating information.
______ means having an eye for new things and striking things that are unusual.
Curiosity
Curiosity means having an eye for new things and striking things that are unusual.

Wunmi Owolabi

mind

feature
